summary: All nine reference-book defect items from the appendix review are resolved: eight fixed, one (a bare @machine-appendix reference) closed as not-reproducing. The unflagged Phase 1 sync-check blocker (5-then-9 Check-1 violations from uncommitted editorial TODO comments in the off-limits appendix) was cleared first via whitelisting. The #show ref rule was rewritten to read the target heading's own supplement/numbering dynamically, fixing the run-together-counter bug and giving both back-matter appendices real letter identities (Appendix A / Appendix B). Three Lean docstrings, one module README, and two chapters had a false Axiom-is-Prop-valued claim corrected to the true Type-valuedness fact; axiom-count figures were re-verified from live source (29 total, 27 in tryAxiomMatch, omitted set {prior_U_gap, sep}) and the chapter now sources its total from the generated axiom-count. DecisionResult's chapter description was corrected from a false three-way split to its real four constructors. The introduction's project-structure list was completed (including a newly-landed HybridLanguage/ directory found via live listing) and its tooling attribution corrected. The machine appendix's untl/snce table letters were swapped to the book's own guard-first convention. Template hygiene: #item now hangs indented via native list(), and the build is warning-free using DejaVu Sans. All four acceptance gates (typst compile, typst-sync-check.sh, lake build --wfail, pdftotext grep) are green; all six touched chapter/appendix pages were rendered and visually inspected.

artifacts.summary: Item-by-item disposition for all nine defects, verification evidence for all four acceptance gates, and residual-risk notes.

notes: A significant, unrelated concurrent Claude Code session (a different task, working on FormalSystem/*Language/ extensions -- HybridLanguage, QuantLanguage) ran throughout this task's entire execution, repeatedly changing FormalSystem/ file and line counts and, at one point, running its own full `lake build FormalSystem` through the same build-guard lock. Every commit in this task was staged by explicit path (never a whole-file or directory add on files carrying mixed ownership) to keep that work out of this task's commits.

typst/chapters/ax-lean-appendix.typ carries a pre-existing, still-uncommitted, out-of-scope diff (three editorial `// TODO:` review comments marking exposition gaps), present before this task started. A partial-hunk git-apply-to-index technique (documented in the phase handoffs) was used every time this task needed to commit its own edit to that same file's title/numbering block, so the foreign TODO comments were never swept into this task's commits.
tryAxiomMatch's own list length ("27") remains a typed numeral with no generator, per the plan's own recorded Non-Goal -- a residual manual-maintenance risk if the list changes again.
